title: Retain loaded Bevy asset handles
why: AssetServer load methods return strong handles that keep loading or loaded assets alive; immediately discarding the handle makes the request ineffective or allows the asset to be unloaded.
suggestion: Store the handle in a component, resource, asset collection, or another owner for as long as the asset is needed.
limitations: Only standalone load, load_untyped, and load_folder calls through a direct Res<AssetServer> binding, including let _ discards, are reported.
Aliases, wrapper methods, deliberate cache warming, and handles retained through indirect APIs are not inferred.
